Boyd Watterson Asset Management LLC OH lowered its position in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 1.3% in the third quarter, Holdings Channel reports. The institutional investor owned 18,117 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 231 shares during the quarter. Apple comprises approximately 2.3% of Boyd Watterson Asset Management LLC OH’s holdings, making the stock its 8th largest position. Boyd Watterson Asset Management LLC OH’s holdings in Apple were worth $4,090,000 at the end of the most recent quarter.
Several other hedge funds and other institutional investors have also recently made changes to their positions in the company. MinichMacGregor Wealth Management LLC increased its holdings in Apple by 13.5% in the 3rd quarter. MinichMacGregor Wealth Management LLC now owns 2,168 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $492,000 after purchasing an additional 258 shares during the last quarter. Moller Financial Services acquired a new stake in Apple in the 3rd quarter valued at approximately $226,000. Peavine Capital LLC increased its holdings in Apple by 4.2% in the 3rd quarter. Peavine Capital LLC now owns 7,260 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,639,000 after purchasing an additional 292 shares during the last quarter. MERIAN GLOBAL INVESTORS UK Ltd increased its holdings in Apple by 3.5% in the 3rd quarter. MERIAN GLOBAL INVESTORS UK Ltd now owns 1,061,659 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $239,658,000 after purchasing an additional 36,321 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Intercontinental Wealth Advisors LLC increased its holdings in Apple by 13.6% in the 3rd quarter. Intercontinental Wealth Advisors LLC now owns 9,398 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $2,122,000 after purchasing an additional 1,128 shares during the last quarter. Institutional investors and hedge funds own 57.04% of the company’s stock. Get Apple alerts:
Shares of NASDAQ:AAPL opened at $155.86 on Friday. Apple Inc. has a 12 month low of $142.00 and a 12 month high of $233.47. The company has a current ratio of 1.12, a quick ratio of 1.09 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87. The firm has a market cap of $752.36 billion, a P/E ratio of 13.09, a P/E/G ratio of 1.45 and a beta of 1.23.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 EPS for the quarter, topping the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $2.78 by $0.13. Apple had a net margin of 22.41% and a return on equity of 48.68%. The firm had revenue of $62.90 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $61.55 billion. During the same period last year, the business earned $2.07 EPS. Apple’s revenue for the quarter was up 19.6% compared to the same quarter last year. Equities analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 12.1 EPS for the current fiscal year.
Several analysts recently weighed in on AAPL shares. JPMorgan Chase & Co. reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $228.00 target price on shares of Apple in a report on Friday, January 11th. Citigroup dropped their target price on shares of Apple from $265.00 to $240.00 and set a “buy” rating for the company in a report on Friday, November 2nd. Rosenblatt Securities set a $165.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the company a “neutral” rating in a report on Thursday, December 6th. Morgan Stanley raised their price target on shares of Apple from $226.00 to $253.00 and gave the company an “overweight” rating in a research report on Thursday, November 8th. Finally, Royal Bank of Canada set a $240.00 price target on shares of Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research report on Monday, September 24th. Three investment analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-five have issued a hold rating and twenty-two have assigned a buy rating to the stock. The company presently has a consensus rating of “Hold” and a consensus price target of $195.19.
In related news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of Apple stock in a transaction on Monday, November 19th. The shares were sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total transaction of $647,520.00. Following the sale, the insider now directly owns 8,940 shares in the company, valued at approximately $1,698,600. Apple Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
